description: Wrapper-only minimization of the geometry-suffix ordering package using fixed pid-scoped temp files.

build.packaging: Minified geometry-suffix Python wrapper with fixed pid-scoped temp files.

basis: Same decoded backend, same cmix-compressed dictionary, and same suffix geometry ordering key as the parent package; only wrapper source changed.
deps: C++ runtime for the bundled cmix/fx2 binary

10m_lzma_proxy.basis: No-lock page_order_screen.py proxy over reordered raw XML, not a Hutter score.

verdict: High-priority exact scorer candidate. The package is smaller than geometry/title packages and the suffix order wins the 10M no-lock LZMA proxy, but no exact cmix backend gate is recorded yet.
